review: Court disposition does not establish physical custody

profiles.finding: The Supreme Court opinion establishes concurrent five- and three-year sentences and the December 11, 1961 remand. It does not establish actual confinement, admission, or release. No custody endpoint or served total added. Final post-remand disposition remains unresolved.

Justice Department contemporary reports confirm the December 15, 1959 verdict, concurrent 60-day sentences, and June 26, 1961 reversal/remand. None establishes actual jail service or a physical release date. Do not substitute the reversal date or sentence length for custody.
